title: How do we draw the letter M with given angles?
description: The middle V of the letter M is drawn first with sixty degrees between its arms. Then a leg is drawn at each top end, making forty degrees with the arm on the outer side.
teaching_notes: One idea: build the letter from its middle and use the protractor at each vertex with its zero line along an arm. Watch for students who put the forty degrees on the inner side of the arm.

video_script.why: The child draws the middle angle first, and then the two side angles, using the protractor at each vertex.
video_script.substitution: Middle V with 60 degrees between two equal arms, then a leg at 40 degrees from each arm on the outer side.
video_script.anchor: an empty board with a protractor and a ruler
video_script.payoff_line: Draw the middle first, and then the two sides

final_answer.value: the letter M with 40° at each side and 60° in the middle
final_answer.spoken: the letter M has forty degrees at each side and sixty degrees in the middle

never_show: a middle angle drawn on the outer side of an arm
maths_rules: each side angle = 40°, measured between a leg and the arm of the middle V, on the outer side
with equal arms the M is symmetric: the two arms of the V make 30° each with the middle line
video_script.design: One board. The middle V is teal, the two side angles are amber, and the protractor is moved to each vertex in turn.
open_questions: The book solution shows only a drawing; the legs lean a little outward (about 10 degrees from the vertical), which follows from 40 and 60.
